settings.title: Together We Rise, Together We Stand

settings.editor: Mwangaza Integrated Project fights for the rights of communities along the Sondu Miriu, Kabondo East — through evidence, advocacy, and unity.
We develop efficient, healthy communities through food security, capacity building, and rights advocacy in Kabondo East, Kenya.

settings.title: Six Challenges. One Community. One Voice.

settings.editor: AfriNov's situation analysis of Kabondo East identified six critical, interconnected issues Mwangaza is actively working to resolve.
Families fish and farm in the dark — no cold storage, no studying after sunset.
Limited access to clean, safe water for drinking and irrigation.
Communities remain cut off from markets, hospitals, and services.
River grass blocks fishing access and destroys livelihoods along the Sondu Miriu.
The nearest dispensary is too far for most families.
Community members lack title deeds to land they have farmed for generations.

settings.title: We fought for 20 years along this river. Now we have a voice in Parliament.

settings.editor: — [Name], CBO member, Kabondo East

For over two decades, communities along the Sondu Miriu dam faced displacement and silence. Mwangaza changed that — equipping members with the tools to turn protest into principled advocacy, and local grievances into parliamentary action.
Mwangaza works with local, national, and international partners to amplify community voices.
There are three ways to stand with Mwangaza.
